{{Top|leg}}
'''Press-chem tubes''' were part of the system that [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] used to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Tibanna [[Gas/Legends|gas]] was drawn from the atmosphere into the heavily pressured tubes<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> where it was stabilized<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and then moved to the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]].<ref name="GG2" />
